text:
maria: Deploybot blocked RC-3201 canary: vulnerability scan shows CVE-2025-9999 (medium) in a transitive crate only present in the arm64 build variant. Also SBOM for the arm build hash doesn't match the published artifact. Change window ends in ~6h. Thoughts: carve out APAC canary, pin to amd64 image, or abort? @anita @sasha

deploybot: [automated] release-scan status=blocked release=rc-3201 reason=scan_cve_found details=arm64:CVEs:[CVE-2025-9999]; sbom_mismatch=arm64-hash-mismatch artifact=service-worker-arm64
```
scan-summary:
- amd64: no new CVEs
- arm64: 1 medium CVE (transitive crate)
- sbom: arm64 build metadata hash != registry metadata
```

anita: Initial triage: CVE appears in transitive crate only pulled by a debug-only feature. Risk is low for production, but SBOM mismatch is surprising. Could be a build pipeline race that produced an unindexed image. We need to confirm whether artifact in registry is actually the one deployed.

sasha: If it's an indexed-but-unmatched artifact we should avoid deploying arm64 to prod. Options: 1) carve out region that serves arm64 (ap-southeast) and proceed with amd64-only rollout, 2) pin to previous stable image for arm64 (rc-3198), or 3) hold entire rollout until artifact and SBOM are reconciled.

maria: Traffic for ap-southeast is low; we could do a regional carveout for 24 hours and continue global canary on amd64. That buys us time to re-run the arm pipeline and reproduce SBOM. Legal/security need to sign off on carveout.

legal: We need a short release note and a compliance entry: "Arm64 variant temporarily excluded from ap-southeast canary due to SBOM/hash mismatch and a transitive-vuln flag. No amd64 impact. Full rollout paused for arm64 until artifact verification." I can approve that statement if security approves risk rationale.

anita: Approve carveout with controls: - block arm64 traffic in ap-southeast via routing rule - enable edge request sampling for 100% of arm64 requests (to catch any stray traffic) - set auto-failover to rc-3198 for any arm64 node that reports new CVE evidence. Also request that build team re-run reproducible build and push a signed SBOM within 6h.

dev-oncall: I'll prepare a quick route rule: `redwoodctl routing exclude --region ap-southeast --image-arch arm64 --release rc-3201` and a fallback policy `redwoodctl routing fallback --region ap-southeast --fallback-release rc-3198`. Will apply after legal ok.

sasha: Add monitoring: create rule vuln_regional_delta_rc_3201 that alerts if any arm64 host shows the CVE pattern or if 1% of requests hit arm64 after carveout. Link to runbook set to releases/rc-3201/arm64-carveout.

maria: Proposal: 1) Apply regional carveout for ap-southeast for arm64 now. 2) Timebox 6h for rebuild and SBOM push. 3) If signed SBOM appears and scan clears, remove carveout and continue. 4) If not resolved, pin arm64 to rc-3198 and document in release notes. Sound good?

anita: That matches security posture. If build team can't reproduce SBOM we should assume artifact integrity risk and prefer pin+rollback.

deploybot: [automated] requested actions pending: apply-carveout, create-alerts, publish-release-note.

maria: dev-oncall go ahead with routing exclusion. After that, can we start global canary (amd64) only?

dev-oncall: Applying now. Command output: ```
> redwoodctl routing exclude --region ap-southeast --image-arch arm64 --release rc-3201
OK: routing rule created: rr-882
> redwoodctl routing fallback --region ap-southeast --fallback-release rc-3198
OK: fallback created: fb-443
```

deploybot: [automated] routing-update applied rr-882 by dev-oncall at 4876543370; fallback fb-443 attached.

maria: Starting amd64-only canary now. deploybot, start rollout for amd64 targets.

deploybot: [automated] canary rollout started: rc-3201 (amd64-only) -> global-canary at 4876543420. rollout_id=r-66aa

sasha: Alerting rule created: vuln_regional_delta_rc_3201. Will notify #security and #incidents for any arm64 hits.

legal: Release note draft: https://docs.internal/releases/rc-3201-notes "Arm64 build excluded from APAC canary due to SBOM hash mismatch and transitive CVE flag. Affected variant pinned to previous stable if not resolved within 6h." Approved.

maria: Timebox set to 6h (deadline 4876566810). If signed SBOM and clean scan appear before then, we'll re-include arm64. If not, we'll pin arm64 to rc-3198 and record in release notes. Closing for now. Re-open if any hit or vendor update. :white_check_mark:
